subject: Kickoff: batch-size science for our training fleet
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the batch-science workstream. Our open-source study measured, across workloads, how increasing batch size changes steps-to-result: a perfect-scaling regime, then diminishing returns, then a workload-dependent maximal-data-parallelism ceiling. Right now Meridian teams pick batch sizes by folklore, and Ines tells me our average accelerator utilization embarrasses everyone.

Goal: reproduce the measurement methodology on three internal workloads (retrieval tower, ranker, and one LM fine-tune) and ship a batch-size scaling playbook plus tooling that recommends per-workload batch/LR settings.

Milestones: methodology port + the ~802MB reference data reproduced by mid-March; internal workload curves by mid-April; playbook and launch review by 5/4.

Bruno owns staffing and infra coordination.

Anders
